parsed.reason: Both descriptions identify the same defect: Flask.run() uses server_name.partition(":") on SERVER_NAME, which splits an IPv6 literal like [::1]:port at the first colon, producing host "[" and a bogus port string that makes int(sn_port) raise ValueError. Description A adds extra detail about the explicit-port case and bracketed addresses without a port, and Description B adds a note about the previous urlsplit code, but the root cause and failure are the same.
